<subject>Re: moving forward</subject>
<body>
Congratulations, I thought you were joining Medisafe. How long before you return to clinical practice?

---

From: s.dupont@lumieresante.fr  
To: s.dupont@lumieresante.fr  
Subject: moving forward  

I have tendered my resignation from Lumière Santé as of today. It was a tough decision because I have truly enjoyed my time here, even if it was brief. I will remain in the healthcare sector, continuing much of the same work I am doing now. I believe this new opportunity is the best choice for my professional growth and my family’s future in the long term. I look forward to staying in touch with all of you and will reach out once I am settled in the coming weeks.  

Home phone: 04 56 78 90 12  
Personal email: dupont.sophie@mail.fr  

Best regards,  
Sophie  
</body>
